content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational, professional, and age criteria prescribed for the post of Senior Software Developer. Preferred Skills: PHP (Core & Framework), PostgreSQL, HTML5, Javascript/Jquery, experience in any CMS. Desired Skills: Node JS/Angular, Experience in AI/ML/NLP Tools. Candidates born between 02/01/1985 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. The date for determining whether a candidate possesses the qualification and age eligibility shall be the date fixed for closure of the online application process.

rows.qualification_required: MCA / B.Tech (IT/CS/ECE) or equivalent / M.Sc (Electronics/CS) with a minimum of 3 years of experience in software development.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure of appointment is 1 year on a contract basis. The consolidated remuneration (CTC) is Rs. 60,000/- (Rupees Sixty Thousand only) per month. The person appointed will have no claim for regularization under any circumstances and must execute an agreement with the High Court fixing and regulating conditions of service.

content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Senior Software Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: Design, Development, Implementation and Maintenance of the Learning Management System (LMS) in the Kerala Judicial Academy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala High Court Senior Software Developer
content_sections.text: Complete "One Time Registration" using the "One Time Registration Login" link on the recruitment portal website. Log in to the profile, select the "My Profile" option from the dashboard, and enter the required details. Select the "Upload documents" option from the dashboard and upload self-attested copies of educational qualifications (with recognition certificates if applicable) and experience certificates proving 3+ years of experience in software development. Select the 'Apply Now' option in the dashboard, review the application preview, and submit the online application. Complete the application fee payment process of Rs. 500/- through online methods (Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking) or using a system-generated Fee Payment Challan for offline payment.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection will be on the basis of a Written Test/MCQ, Programming Test, and Interview, or a Programming Test and Interview, having regard to the number of applications received vis-a-vis the number of vacancies. Candidates who secure a minimum of 50% marks in the programming test will be called for an interview. However, if the number of qualified candidates is disproportionately high, the High Court will decide a short list based on the number of vacancies notified. The written test/MCQ, if any, and Programming Test are for shortlisting candidates, and the marks in the interview alone will be considered for final selection.
